html:
Dési Bouterse was a Surinamese army officer who seized power in 1980 and dominated the country's politics for four decades. He ruled behind the scenes in the 1980s and was elected president in 2010.

On 25 February 1980 he led sixteen sergeants in a coup against the government of Henck Arron. In December 1982 fifteen leading critics were killed at Fort Zeelandia, the December murders. The Netherlands cut off aid. A war with Maroon rebels followed in the late 1980s, the Interior War.

A Dutch court convicted him of drug trafficking in 1999. He returned to power through elections and was president from 2010 to 2020. In 2019 a court in Suriname found him guilty of the December murders. He went into hiding when the sentence was upheld in 2023, and died the next year.
sum: Dési Bouterse was a Surinamese army officer who seized power in 1980 and dominated the country's politics for four decades. He ruled behind the scenes in the 1980s and was elected president in 2010.
